itemized.notes: REPORT 1 OF 2 IN A GENUINE MULTI-REPORT BUNDLE (one of only two in the whole utah_county corpus; ADDENDUM D §D1 names this file). `report_index` = 1. THE SPLIT WAS DETERMINED FROM THE PAGES' OWN PRINTED DATES AND HEADINGS, never from an assumed page count: pp1-5 are the 6-15-14 ORIGINAL (p1 cover signed '6-15-14', amendment box ticked NO, clerk's received stamp 'JUN 16 PM 3:49'; p2 Summary Page foliated 'Page 1 of 4' Date of Report 6-15-14; p3 Schedule A 'Page 2 of 4' 6-15-14; p4 Schedule B 'Page 3 of 4' 6-15-14; p5 Schedule B 'Page 4 of 4' 6-15-14 — four sheets, cover EXCLUDED from the count, and every sheet carries the 6-15-14 report date in its own identity box). pp6-8 are a SEPARATE report dated 6-19-14 and are transcribed in the second record of this file; NOTHING from them is merged here and this report's schedules were gated ONLY by this report's own cover. Page-face candidate 'Jeffrey R. Buhman', party Republican, Office Seeking 'Utah County Attorney' — index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the page face supplies it. Both reports tick 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election'. FORM: the common 2014 blank on the cover ('2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES', Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5), but the schedule sheets are the 2012-throwback template — address column headed 'Mailing Address & Zip Code' and SCHEDULE B REUSING 'Name of Contributor' over the vendor column, with no Purpose column anywhere (ADDENDUM D §D2 / E §E2; headings read off each page). A VOIDED PRINTED LINE CONSUMES A ROW (§C4): p3's printed line 12 carries only faint grey ghost strokes in the Date, Name and Address cells — nothing legible, no blue ink, and NO amount, still illegible re-cropped at 1600 dpi — so the last contribution sits on printed line 13 and `line_no` skips 12. No arithmetic gate could see this: the twelve amounts sum to the printed subtotal with or without it. REDACTION IS UPSTREAM AND SELECTIVE ON THIS FILING: the county blacked out the CANDIDATE'S own street address and phone on both covers (p1, p6), but left every DONOR and VENDOR street address on the schedules fully visible — those are reduced to city/state at read time and never written into this record.
